Additionally, in the binding file, output.data_ptr<int64_t>() returns a long int* while the launcher expects long long*, causing an invalid conversion in the remainder wrapper. The minimal fix is to add proper shape parameters to ge_scalar_kernel (or avoid unnecessary decoding if input is contiguous) and pass the correct arguments from the launcher; also align the launcher signatures and pointer types in the binding.
